rules: God, Absolute, and Transcendent Zero are mutually exclusive session transformations.
All form abilities use TransformationOnly resources with an exact RequiredTransformationId.
Physical world-bending effects are bounded project adapters; no ability may bypass authored boss immunity, destination validation, publication rules, or performance budgets.

forms.name: God Form
forms.fantasy: Temporary godhood emphasizes domain control, elemental authority, survival, and colossal presence without rewriting core encounter laws.

abilities.name: Storm Genesis
abilities.guardrail: Creates a bounded authored storm domain; never changes global island weather state without the event director.

abilities.name: Gravity Throne
abilities.guardrail: Applies authored movement/gravity-like pressure only to eligible actors and project-bound zones.

abilities.name: Phoenix Ascension
abilities.guardrail: Provides bounded recovery/rebirth behavior through supported health, teleport, or checkpoint logic; no unrestricted immortality.

abilities.name: Celestial Mandate
abilities.guardrail: Grants temporary support authority to an eligible ally without duplicating permanent unlocks.

abilities.name: Titanheart Edict
abilities.guardrail: Creates temporary stagger/fortitude authority; does not make the player universally immune.

forms.name: Absolute Form
forms.fantasy: Absolute form temporarily bends local encounter rules and spatial relationships, categorically above God while remaining below Transcendent Zero.

abilities.name: Chrono Rupture
abilities.guardrail: Uses bounded slow, replay, or timing-window simulation; never rewinds authoritative world state.

abilities.name: Void Dominion
abilities.guardrail: Suppresses only explicitly eligible temporary constructs, summons, or hazards inside a bounded domain.

abilities.name: Axiom Dominion
abilities.guardrail: Changes one whitelisted encounter rule through the objective/controller that owns that rule.

abilities.name: Boundary Rewrite
abilities.guardrail: Creates validated temporary routes, phase gates, or boundary changes; never teleports into invalid geometry.

abilities.name: Sovereign Paradox
abilities.guardrail: Combines authored effects only when their encounter contracts explicitly permit the interaction.
